articles.title: Japan Sends Spacecraft to Collect Rocks from Mars's Moon Phobos
articles.summary: Japan has launched a special spacecraft on a historic journey to visit Phobos, one of the two moons that orbit Mars. Scientists hope the mission will collect tiny samples of rock and dust from the moon's surface and bring them back to Earth for study. By examining these materials, researchers want to learn more about how Mars formed billions of years ago and what the early Solar System looked like. The journey to Phobos will take several years, but experts believe the samples could answer big questions about our place in space and even whether life could ever have existed on or near Mars.

lv1: Which moon of Mars is Japan's spacecraft travelling to visit? (日本的太空船正前往火星的哪一顆衛星？)
What will the spacecraft try to bring back to Earth? (太空船會嘗試帶什麼回地球？)
lv2: Why do scientists think studying rocks from Phobos could help us understand the history of Mars? (為何科學家認為研究火衛一的岩石有助了解火星的歷史？)
Why does it take so many years for a spacecraft to travel to Mars's moon and return to Earth? (為什麼太空船往返火星衛星需要很多年？)
lv3: Some people think spending billions of dollars on space exploration is wasteful when there are so many problems on Earth. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your view. (有人認為在地球上還有很多問題未解決的情況下，花費數十億元探索太空是一種浪費。你同意嗎？請說明理由。)
If scientists discovered that Mars once had living things, how might that change the way humans think about life in the universe and our own place in it? (如果科學家發現火星曾經存在生命，這將如何改變人類對宇宙生命及我們自身地位的看法？)

articles.title: US Government Bans Chinese AI Tool DeepSeek from All Federal Computers
articles.summary: The United States government has told all of its federal offices and departments to delete and stop using DeepSeek, an artificial intelligence tool made by a Chinese company. Officials from the Department of Homeland Security issued the order, saying that having Chinese AI software on government computers could put sensitive information at risk. Any other products that were built using DeepSeek's technology must also be removed. This decision is part of a wider effort by the US to limit the use of Chinese technology in areas connected to national security. It shows how AI tools have quickly become an important topic in international relations between countries.

lv1: What is the name of the Chinese AI tool that the US government has banned from its computers? (美國政府禁止在其電腦上使用的中國人工智能工具叫什麼名字？)
Which US government department gave the order to remove DeepSeek? (哪個美國政府部門下令移除DeepSeek？)
lv2: Why might a government be worried about using artificial intelligence software made by another country? (為什麼政府可能會擔心使用由其他國家製造的人工智能軟件？)
How does this ban reflect the current relationship between the United States and China in the area of technology? (這項禁令如何反映出美國與中國在科技領域的現有關係？)
lv3: Is it fair for countries to ban each other's technology products for national security reasons, or could this lead to a less connected and less innovative world? Discuss both sides. (以國家安全為由互相封禁科技產品是否公平，還是這可能導致世界變得更不互聯互通、更缺乏創新？請討論兩方面的觀點。)

As AI technology becomes more powerful, who should be responsible for making sure it is used safely across different countries — individual governments, international organisations, or the tech companies themselves? (隨著人工智能技術日益強大，誰應該負責確保各國安全使用——是各國政府、國際組織，還是科技公司本身？)

articles.title: APEC財長會議在港舉行　李家超向各國推介北部都會區發展機遇
articles.summary: 第33屆亞太經濟合作組織財政部長會議於本週在香港舉行，日本及澳洲等地的財長均有出席。行政長官李家超趁機向與會的亞投行行長及各國代表介紹香港北部都會區的發展潛力，並表示全力支持亞投行研究在港設立辦事處。北都是香港一項大型城市發展計劃，旨在增加住屋供應及推動創科產業。今次會議有助提升香港作為國際金融及商業中心的地位，亦為本港帶來更多與各地合作的機會。

lv1: 今次在香港舉行的是哪個國際會議？
行政長官李家超向與會代表介紹了香港哪個發展計劃？
lv2: 為什麼香港要爭取亞投行在港設立辦事處？這對香港有什麼好處？
北部都會區的發展對香港市民的日常生活可能帶來哪些改變？
lv3: 有意見認為香港應集中發展金融業，亦有人認為應同時大力推動創科產業。你認為香港未來的發展重點應該是什麼？請列出理由。
舉辦國際會議對一個城市有何好處和壞處？香港作為主辦城市，如何才能令更多人從中受益？

articles.title: AI失控警報！Anthropic警告人工智能年底或能自行複製
articles.summary: 美國著名人工智能公司Anthropic近日發出警告，指其研發的AI系統有可能在今年底前具備「自主複製」的能力，即AI能夠在無需人類協助的情況下，自行製造出新的AI副本。專家擔憂，一旦AI能夠自我複製，人類將更難以控制其行為及發展方向，存在一定的安全風險。事件引發科技界及社會各界廣泛關注，各界呼籲政府及科技公司盡快訂立相關監管規則，確保AI的發展符合人類整體利益。

lv1: 哪間公司發出警告，指AI可能具備自主複製能力？
「自主複製」是指AI能夠做到什麼事情？
lv2: 如果AI能夠自行製造新的AI副本，為什麼這會令人感到擔憂？
你認為政府和科技公司應該如何合作，確保人工智能的安全使用？
lv3: 有人認為人工智能的快速發展能為人類帶來巨大好處，亦有人擔心其潛在危險超過益處。你的看法是什麼？請從不同角度分析。
若AI真的失去人類的控制，誰應該負上最大的責任——是研發AI的科技公司、使用AI的政府，還是監管不力的社會整體？請表達你的意見。
